title: OpenCode governance adapter and controlled runner contract
objective: Reconstruct the approved opt-in OpenCode adapter, verified navigation and controlled AO interface after workspace pruning; rerun checks and independent review before PR publication.

acceptance.description: Opt-in native configuration, five roles and shared procedures preserve legacy adapters and authority.
Trusted data-only guards reject unsafe/inherited weakened native contracts, nested skill identities and legacy mode aliases.
Scoped navigation binds selected role and required procedures including independent plan review; changed context fails.
Real Copier initial/update and legacy tests preserve local files and installation choices.
AO contract covers supported fresh ACP/chat launch, resume and queued/delegated admission; TUI and unsupported isolation remain denied.
Native Windows/Linux and real-model qualification have separate honest observed states; unsupported activation remains blocked.
Fresh full checks, predecessor compatibility, two independent Full reviews and triage/Delta close confirmed findings.
Published PR remote tree verified with visible Codex request and actual CI/review outcomes.

manual_evidence: Fresh independent plan, quality, twoFull, separatetriage and necessaryDelta records
Actual native CLI evidence separate from model qualification

stop_conditions: Failed required check without resolved diagnosis
Unexpected overwrite or weakening of local policy
forbidden_actions: Automatic downstream activation or settings changes
